statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of transient neurological deficits consistent with prior transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a known history of cerebral infarction
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) was ordered
The service is to evaluate for potential paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other arrhythmias that may be contributing to embolic events
The diagnosis codes are G45.9 and I34.0
The denial reason code is CO-97
The denial is based on the service being bundled into another covered procedure
